evidence_snippets: However, given that Pub/Sub has at-least-once delivery semantics by default, your subscribers are already resilient to message redelivery.
Both ordered delivery and exactly once delivery offer their guarantees within a region.
Pub/Sub offers at-least-once delivery for all messages published.
